//: Development-only defaults (docs/development/local-dev.md): throwaway file-backed SQLite + dev header auth. Never used outside ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development; production stays PostgreSQL via appsettings.School.json (ADR-0001).

Database.//SeedSyntheticData: Synthetic seeding is opt-in and set only by the dotnet-run launch profile (Properties/launchSettings.json), so tests keep an empty database.

DevAuth.//: Header auth (X-Dev-Subject / X-Dev-Roles) so the app runs with no Entra tenant. MUST remain false in any school deployment.

EventTemplates.//: Directory of event-template JSON documents ({key}.json); applied via POST /api/v1/carnivals/{id}/apply-template. Deployments mount ./config into the container and point this at /config/event-templates.
